note: GTA VI is not released yet, so every guide below is built from the official trophy descriptions plus the mission and chapter structure those descriptions name. Where a detail is not verifiable, the guide says what the description states and cites the list source; it never invents a walkthrough step.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum: it unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is no separate task. Follow the roadmap in this guide — story first, then stranger missions, collectibles, activities, and the 100% cleanup — and this pops last. Expect roughly 200 hours for the full run, most of it on the 100% completion trophy. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4 out of 10 for difficulty, so the time is the challenge here, not the skill — plan on a long, steady grind rather than a hard one.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion. This is the hardest trophy and the long grind: it tracks story, stranger missions, collectibles, activities and challenges, so it only pops once everything else on the 100% checklist is done. Use the in-game stats and checklist to see what is left, and finish it last before the platinum. PowerPyx notes the checklist is closer to 60% true completion — you need 200 of the 277 vehicle models and 100 of the 255 animals, and only 70 of the 80 challenges, so you can skip the hardest ones.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps, near-misses and airtime the game counts as you drive and ride around Leonida; just keep playing and they add up. Use fast bikes and cars and hit ramps and jumps deliberately to speed it up. There are 397 stunts in total across Leonida, and the 100% checklist asks for 300 of them, so you have room to skip the trickiest jumps.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. There are 9 activity types in the game; sample one of each (races, shooting range, fishing, arcade, bowling, meditation, drone races, and the rest) and the trophy pops. It is a taster, not a grind — one try of each is enough. The nine types are fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt — one of each is all it takes.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. There are 42 shooting range challenges; you need gold on every one. Practise each range's weapon and target pattern, and replay any you miss — the ranges are repeatable, so nothing here is missable. The 42 challenges are spread across 12 shooting ranges, so work through them range by range rather than hunting for them.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: One meditation spot is at Jason's house in Chapter 1 — meditate there before the story moves on, or you may not be able to return.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. There are 18 meditation spots; visit each and meditate. This is the one trophy flagged as possibly missable: one meditation spot is at Jason's house in Chapter 1, so meditate there before the story moves on, or you may not be able to return. Do it early. The last meditation cannot be done until you can play as both characters, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, so don't expect to finish this in Chapter 1.

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK app at 100 different locations across Leonida. This is a sweep — work through the map systematically and the count climbs; the app tells you when a location is done. The app marks landmarks, curiosities and sculptures, so sweep those first — they are the easiest locations to find and scan.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. There are 80 challenges in total; finish any 50. They span driving, combat, exploration and activities, so just play broadly and they accumulate. The 80 challenges sit in eight groups of ten, so pick the two easiest groups and finish those to reach 50 with the least friction.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears. Use alleys and cover to lose the search, and don't let your partner get caught. One reliable escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — the police struggle to follow along the tracks and the helicopter loses sight of you.
